operations.name: GetServiceCapabilities
operations.description: This operation returns the capabilities of the service. An ONVIF compliant device which provides the Door Control service shall implement this method.

fields.name: Capabilities

definition.name: ServiceCapabilities
definition.description:
ServiceCapabilities structure reflects optional functionality of a service.
						The information is static and does not change during device operation.
						The following capabilities are available:

attributes.name: MaxLimit
attributes.description:
The maximum number of entries returned by a single Get<Entity>List or
							Get<Entity> request. The device shall never return more than this number of entities
							in a single response.

attributes.name: MaxDoors
attributes.description: Indicates the maximum number of doors supported by the device.

attributes.name: ClientSuppliedTokenSupported
attributes.description:
Indicates that the client is allowed to supply the token when creating doors.
							To enable the use of the command SetDoor, the value must be set to true.

attributes.name: DoorManagementSupported
attributes.description:
Indicates that the client can perform CRUD operations (create, read, update and delete)
							on doors. To enable the use of the commands GetDoors, GetDoorList, CreateDoor, ModifyDoor
							and DeleteDoor, the value must be set to true.

fields.description:
The capability response message contains the requested DoorControl
									service capabilities using a hierarchical XML capability structure.

operations.name: GetDoorInfoList
operations.description: This operation requests a list of all DoorInfo items provided by the device. An ONVIF compliant device that provides Door Control service shall implement this method. A call to this method shall return a StartReference when not all data is returned and more data is available. The reference shall be valid for retrieving the next set of data. The number of items returned shall not be greater than Limit parameter.

fields.name: Limit
fields.description:
Maximum number of entries to return. If Limit is omitted or if the
									value of Limit is higher than what the device supports, then the device shall
									return its maximum amount of entries.

fields.name: StartReference
fields.description:
Start returning entries from this start reference. If not specified,
									entries shall start from the beginning of the dataset.

fields.name: NextStartReference
fields.description:
StartReference to use in next call to get the following items. If
									absent, no more items to get.

fields.name: DoorInfo

definition.name: DoorInfo
definition.description:
The DoorInfo type represents the Door as a physical object.
						The structure contains information and capabilities of a specific door instance.
						An ONVIF compliant device shall provide the following fields for each Door instance:

base_definition.name: DataEntity
base_definition.description:
General data structure referenced by a token.
				Should be used as extension base.

attributes.name: token

definition.name: ReferenceToken
definition.description:
Type used to reference logical and physical entities.
			Token may be extended by intermediate terminal with adding prefix to make it global unique.
			The length should be within 36 characters for generating as a local token.
			See "Remote Token" section in Resource Query specification.

attributes.description: A service-unique identifier of the item.

fields.name: Name

definition.name: Name
definition.description: Type used for names of logical and physical entities.

fields.description: A user readable name. It shall be up to 64 characters.

fields.name: Description

definition.name: Description
definition.description:
Description is optional and the maximum length is device specific.
				If the length is more than maximum length, it is silently chopped to the maximum length
				supported by the device/service (which may be 0).

fields.description: A user readable description. It shall be up to 1024 characters.

fields.name: Capabilities

definition.name: DoorCapabilities
definition.description:
DoorCapabilities reflect optional functionality of a particular physical entity.
						Different door instances may have different set of capabilities.
						This information may change during device operation, e.g. if hardware settings are changed.
						The following capabilities are available:

attributes.name: Access
attributes.description:
Indicates whether or not this Door instance supports AccessDoor command to
							perform momentary access.

attributes.name: AccessTimingOverride
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance supports overriding configured timing in the
							AccessDoor command.

attributes.name: Lock
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance supports LockDoor command to lock the
							door.

attributes.name: Unlock
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance supports UnlockDoor command to unlock the
							door.

attributes.name: Block
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance supports BlockDoor command to block the
							door.

attributes.name: DoubleLock
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance supports DoubleLockDoor command to lock
							multiple locks on the door.

attributes.name: LockDown
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance supports LockDown (and LockDownRelease)
							commands to lock the door and put it in LockedDown mode.

attributes.name: LockOpen
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance supports LockOpen (and LockOpenRelease)
							commands to unlock the door and put it in LockedOpen mode.

attributes.name: DoorMonitor
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance has a DoorMonitor and supports the
							DoorPhysicalState event.

attributes.name: LockMonitor
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance has a LockMonitor and supports the
							LockPhysicalState event.

attributes.name: DoubleLockMonitor
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance has a DoubleLockMonitor and supports the
							DoubleLockPhysicalState event.

attributes.name: Alarm
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance supports door alarm and the DoorAlarm
							event.

attributes.name: Tamper
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance has a Tamper detector and supports the
							DoorTamper event.

attributes.name: Fault
attributes.description:
Indicates that this Door instance supports door fault and the DoorFault
							event.

fields.description: The capabilities of the Door.
List of DoorInfo items.

operations.name: GetDoorInfo
operations.description: This operation requests a list of DoorInfo items matching the given tokens. An ONVIF-compliant device that provides Door Control service shall implement this method. The device shall ignore tokens it cannot resolve and shall return an empty list if there are no items matching specified tokens. If the number of requested items is greater than MaxLimit, a TooManyItems fault shall be returned.

			Token may be extended by intermediate terminal with adding prefix to make it global unique.
			The length should be within 36 characters for generating as a local token.
			See "Remote Token" section in Resource Query specification.

A call to this method shall return a StartReference when not all data is returned and more data is available. The reference shall be valid for retrieving the next set of data. 									entries shall start from the beginning of the dataset.

									absent, no more items to get.

fields.description: The capabilities of the Door.

fields.name: DoorType

definition.name: Name
definition.description: Type used for names of logical and physical entities.

fields.description:
The type of door. Is of type text. Can be either one of the following reserved
										ONVIF types: "pt:Door", "pt:ManTrap", "pt:Turnstile", "pt:RevolvingDoor",
										"pt:Barrier", or a custom defined type.

fields.name: Timings

definition.name: Timings
definition.description:
A structure defining times such as how long the door is unlocked when accessed,
						extended grant time, etc.

fields.name: ReleaseTime
fields.description:
When access is granted (door mode becomes Accessed), the latch is unlocked.
								ReleaseTime is the time from when the latch is unlocked until it is
								relocked again (unless the door is physically opened).

fields.name: OpenTime
fields.description:
The time from when the door is physically opened until the door is set in the
								DoorOpenTooLong alarm state.

fields.name: ExtendedReleaseTime
fields.description:
Some individuals need extra time to open the door before the latch relocks.
								If supported, ExtendedReleaseTime shall be added to ReleaseTime if UseExtendedTime
								is set to true in the AccessDoor command.

fields.name: DelayTimeBeforeRelock
fields.description:
If the door is physically opened after access is granted,
								then DelayTimeBeforeRelock is the time from when the door is physically
								opened until the latch goes back to locked state.

fields.name: ExtendedOpenTime
fields.description:
Some individuals need extra time to pass through the door. If supported,
								ExtendedOpenTime shall be added to OpenTime if UseExtendedTime is set to true
								in the AccessDoor command.

fields.name: PreAlarmTime
fields.description:
Before a DoorOpenTooLong alarm state is generated, a signal will sound to indicate
								that the door must be closed. PreAlarmTime defines how long before DoorOpenTooLong
								the warning signal shall sound.

A structure defining times such as how long the door is unlocked when
										accessed, extended grant time, etc.
List of Door items.

operations.name: CreateDoor
operations.description: This operation creates the specified door in the device. The token field of the Door structure shall be empty and the device shall allocate a token for the door. The allocated token shall be returned in the response. If the client sends any value in the token field, the device shall return InvalidArgVal as a generic fault code.

operations.name: SetDoor
operations.description: This method is used to synchronize a door in a client with the device. If a door with the specified token does not exist in the device, the door is created. If a door with the specified token exists, then the door is modified. A call to this method takes a door structure as input parameter. The token field of the Door structure shall not be empty. A device that signals support for the ClientSuppliedTokenSupported capability shall implement this command. If no token was specified in the request, the device shall return InvalidArgs as a generic fault code.

fields.description:
The type of door. Is of type text. Can be either one of the following reserved
										ONVIF types: "pt:Door", "pt:ManTrap", "pt:Turnstile", "pt:RevolvingDoor",
										"pt:Barrier", or a custom defined type.

fields.name: Timings

definition.name: Timings
definition.description:
A structure defining times such as how long the door is unlocked when accessed,
						extended grant time, etc.

fields.name: ReleaseTime
fields.description:
When access is granted (door mode becomes Accessed), the latch is unlocked.
								ReleaseTime is the time from when the latch is unlocked until it is
								relocked again (unless the door is physically opened).

fields.name: OpenTime
fields.description:
The time from when the door is physically opened until the door is set in the
								DoorOpenTooLong alarm state.

fields.name: ExtendedReleaseTime
fields.description:
Some individuals need extra time to open the door before the latch relocks.
								If supported, ExtendedReleaseTime shall be added to ReleaseTime if UseExtendedTime
								is set to true in the AccessDoor command.

fields.name: DelayTimeBeforeRelock
fields.description:
If the door is physically opened after access is granted,
								then DelayTimeBeforeRelock is the time from when the door is physically
								opened until the latch goes back to locked state.

fields.name: ExtendedOpenTime
fields.description:
Some individuals need extra time to pass through the door. If supported,
								ExtendedOpenTime shall be added to OpenTime if UseExtendedTime is set to true
								in the AccessDoor command.

fields.name: PreAlarmTime
fields.description:
Before a DoorOpenTooLong alarm state is generated, a signal will sound to indicate
								that the door must be closed. PreAlarmTime defines how long before DoorOpenTooLong
								the warning signal shall sound.

A structure defining times such as how long the door is unlocked when
										accessed, extended grant time, etc.
The Door item to create or modify

fields.name: DoorMode

definition.name: DoorMode
definition.description:
The DoorMode describe the mode of operation from a logical perspective. 
						Setting a door mode reflects the intent to set a door in a physical state.

enumeration.description: The mode of operation is unknown.

The intention is to set the door to a physical locked state. 
								In this mode the device shall provide momentary access using the AccessDoor 
								method if supported by the door instance.

The intention is to set the door to a physical unlocked state. 
								Alarms related to door timing operations such as open too long 
								or forced open are masked in this mode.

The intention is to momentary set the door to a physical unlocked state. 
								After a predefined time the device shall revert the door to its previous mode. 
								Alarms related to timing operations such as door forced open are masked in this mode.

The intention is to set the door to a physical locked state and the 
								device shall not allow AccessDoor requests, i.e. it is not possible 
								for the door to go to the accessed mode. 
								All other requests to change the door mode are allowed.

The intention is to set the door to a physical locked state and the device 
								shall only allow the LockDownReleaseDoor request. 
								All other requests to change the door mode are not allowed.

The intention is to set the door to a physical unlocked state and the 
								device shall only allow the LockOpenReleaseDoor request. 
								All other requests to change the door mode are not allowed.

The intention is to set the door with multiple locks to a physical double locked state. 
								If the door does not support double locking the devices shall 
								treat this as a normal locked mode. 
								When changing to an unlocked mode from the double locked mode, the physical state 
								of the door may first go to locked state before unlocking.

fields.description:
The logical operating mode of the door; it is of type DoorMode. An ONVIF
								compatible device shall report current operating mode in this field.
The state of the door.

operations.name: AccessDoor
operations.description: This operation allows momentarily accessing a Door. It invokes the functionality typically used when a card holder presents a card to a card reader at the door and is granted access. The DoorMode shall change to Accessed state. Please refer to Accessed mode in section [DoorMode] for more details. The Door shall remain accessible for the defined time. When the time span elapses, the DoorMode shall change back to its previous state. If the request cannot be fulfilled, a Failure fault shall be returned. Please refer to section [DoorMode] for details about Door Modes restrictions. A device that signals support for Access capability for a particular Door instance shall implement this method. A device that signals support for AccessTimingOverride capability for a particular Door instance shall also provide optional timing parameters (AccessTime, OpenTooLongTime and PreAlarmTime) when performing AccessDoor command. The device shall take the best effort approach for parameters not supported, it must fallback to preconfigured time or limit the time to the closest supported time if the specified time is out of range.

operations.name: LockDownDoor
